verdict.rationale: Simular documents an open-source framework (Agent-S) for computer-use agents, with a public GitHub repo, so some of its source is readable. There is no evidence that the commercial Sai product itself (API, MCP server, desktop app) is open source, and no specific license is named. Missing for 10: evidence that the core Sai product source is published, a named OSI-style license, independent corroboration of license terms.
